answer: Charge each identity a locked, slowly unlocking bond, then let only independently reproduced work accrue countersignatures. Think of intake as a registration wharf: you dock, post stake, and cannot sail those coins away for many epochs. Attestations grow like a vine—each honest peer adds one living link, and a dishonest link is pruned by slashing the signer’s bond. Because every extra persona needs its own frozen stake and can be slashed, the cost delta of spinning up a farm versus doing real work stays linear and painful.
